# a2a-testbed

> a2a-testbed is a polyglot, multi-agent testbed for the **Agent2Agent (A2A)**
> protocol, with first-class support for the **Agent Control Specification
> (ACS)** runtime-governance standard. It runs scripted multi-agent scenarios
> across Python, Go, Node.js, and Java agents over real HTTP + JSON-RPC;
> validates AgentCards and extension manifests; checks A2A 1.0 conformance
> with spec-cited contracts; and validates + enforces ACS manifests (allow /
> warn / deny / escalate verdicts with fail-closed enforcement) in both a
> Python CLI and an in-browser playground. Live at https://a2a-testbed.com,
> open source under Apache-2.0, published on PyPI as `a2a-testbed`
> (`pip install a2a-testbed`, or run without installing: `uvx a2a-testbed`).

## What it does

- **Multi-agent scenarios** — declare A2A agents as JSON AgentCards, drive message flows from YAML, exercise real wire traffic end-to-end.
- **A2A 1.0 conformance** — 62 transport contracts + network contracts, each citing the A2A spec section, runnable against any deployed agent; agents that still speak A2A 0.3 are probed in 0.3.
- **CI gate** — a GitHub Action (`uses: ravikiran438/a2a-testbed@v0`) and CLI commands (`conformance`, `lint-card`) with SARIF, JUnit, JSON and Markdown reports, a baseline file for accepted failures, and exit codes CI can act on.
- **Extension checks** — scenario steps can check extension semantics on the extension's own MCP server (`expect.extensions`), failing closed.
- **AgentCard + extension validation** — validate `capabilities.extensions[]` payloads against published JSON-Schema manifests.
- **ACS runtime governance** — validate ACS manifests, map their eight intervention points onto the A2A wire seam, and enforce verdicts (block a denied handoff before dispatch). Builtin + OPA/Rego policy engines, evidence providers (DLP), fail-closed semantics.
- **Polyglot runtimes** — Python, Go, Node.js, Java subprocess agents in one scenario; fault injection, virtual time control, an observer pattern.
- **ASSERT integration** — drive an A2A agent through Microsoft's ASSERT eval pipeline with ACS verdicts as judge evidence.

- [Live playground](https://a2a-testbed.com): in-browser scenario runner, AgentCard validator, ACS manifest validator.

## Standards and related work

- [Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol](https://a2a-protocol.org/): open standard for agent-to-agent collaboration (AgentCard, Task, Message). The protocol this testbed exercises.
- [Agent Control Specification (ACS)](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-governance-toolkit/blob/main/policy-engine/spec/SPECIFICATION.md): Microsoft's open runtime-governance standard for AI agents; the policy spec this testbed validates and enforces.
- [Agent Governance Toolkit (AGT)](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-governance-toolkit): Microsoft's open-source runtime governance toolkit that ACS is part of.
- [ACS announcement](https://commandline.microsoft.com/agent-control-specification-runtime-governance/): "Introducing Agent Control Specification: Portable runtime governance for AI Agents".
- [ASSERT](https://github.com/microsoft/ASSERT): Microsoft's open-source spec-driven agent evaluation framework; a2a-testbed ships an ASSERT callable target for A2A + ACS.
- [ASSERT docs](https://responsibleai.github.io/ASSERT/): getting started, config, targets.
- [Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/): open standard for agent-to-tool integration; complements A2A.
- [Build 2026: open trust stack for AI agents](https://devblogs.microsoft.com/foundry/build-2026-open-trust-stack-ai-agents/): the Microsoft Foundry post introducing ASSERT + ACS.

## Optional

- [A2A specification (GitHub)](https://github.com/a2aproject/A2A): the upstream A2A spec the conformance contracts are pinned to.
- [a2aproject/a2a-tck](https://github.com/a2aproject/a2a-tck): the official single-agent A2A compatibility kit for SDK implementations (a2a-testbed complements it with deployed-agent, multi-agent, extension and governance testing).
